If you delegate any part of this conversation to a sub-call (llm_query/rlm_query), instruct it to end its own response with exactly one line of the form:
  LOCAL FINDING: found instance <k> of query "<query text>" in this slice
or, if the query never appears in its slice:
  LOCAL FINDING: no match for query "<query text>" in this slice
where <query text> is copied verbatim from the query you gave it, and <k> is the count of times that exact query's turn appears WITHIN the slice you gave it (not the whole conversation).
query: What is your favorite coffee blend?
question:
This conversation contains 8 turn(s) where the user asked exactly: "What is your favorite coffee blend?"
Return the content of the assistant's response to the 1st occurrence of that exact question (counting from the start of the conversation).
